question: Who has the rare distinction of being awarded with all top four civilian awards of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bismillah Khan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 

 
 
**Bismillah Khan (1916-2006)**

 
 
 
 
• He is known for his virtuosity in playing **Shehnai.**
 
• Shehnai is a wind instrument.
 
• He was felicitated with the following prestigious awards:
 
 
• **Padma Shri in 1961**
 
• **Padma Bhushan in 1968**
 
• **Padma Vibhushan in 1980**
 
• **Bharat Ratna in 2001**
 
 
 
• **​**Real name: **Qamruddin Khan.**
 
• He** **also played Shehnai at **the first republic day celebration in 1950.**
 
 
 
 

 Ali Akbar Khan (1922-2009)
 
 
 
• He used to play **Sarod.**
 
• **Sarod **is a **string instrument.**
 
• He received the following awards:
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan in 1967**
 
• **Padma Vibhushan in 1989.**
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Amjad Ali Khan
 
 
 
• He is an Indian classical **Sarod** player.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan in 2001.**
 
 
 
 

 Ustad Allah Rakha Qureshi (1919-2000)
 
 
 
• He is a **tabla player **hailing from **Jammu and Kashmir.**
 
• **Tabla **is a **percussion instrument.**
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Shri in 1977.**
